description: This file defines the AccountSwitcherAdapter class, which extends RecyclerView.Adapter to manage and display a list of user accounts in a RecyclerView, handling account selection events.

classes.name: AccountSwitcherAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter managing a list of Account objects for account selection UI.

methods.name: AccountSwitcherAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a callback for account clicks.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item at the given position based on the Account's ID.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder instance for an account item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds account data to the ViewHolder for display.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of accounts in the list.

methods.name: setLocalAccounts
methods.description: Updates the internal list of accounts and refreshes the UI.
